title: Single-Origin Tasting & Meet Your Neighbours
description: A guided tasting of three single-origin pours, with a short talk on what to notice, then open table seating so people can keep talking once the cups are empty.
format: Guided 45-min tasting, then 45 min open seating
intendedSocialExperience: Something to talk about from the first minute: everyone tastes the same thing and compares notes
whySuggested: A small group nearby opted into community demand for food and drink meetups on weekday evenings, and your espresso bar already hosts tastings.
assumptionsToValidate: Three single origins available that week
One barista can lead the tasting
